description: Find retirement / benefit plans by a contribution amount: an exact value, a range, or the participant-minus-employer difference, for one plan year. Reads a per-plan-year index built from the U.S. Department of Labor, EBSA, Form 5500 Schedule H (large plans) and Schedule I (small plans) datasets (stored copy; data_as_of in every response). measure is employer_contributions (default), participant_contributions, total_contributions (Schedule H only; Schedule I has no total line) or participant_minus_employer (participant contributions less employer contributions; needs both boxes filled). Give equals, or min and/or max (whole dollars). Returns up to limit filings with ack_id, EIN, plan number, schedule and all contribution lines; feed an EIN and plan number to form5500_schedule for the full line items. plan_year defaults to the newest stored year. Sponsor names are not in the stored datasets: use form5500_filing with the ack_id or ein. A blank box is never matched as zero.

measure.description: Which amount to filter on (default employer_contributions).

plan_year.description: Plan year (e.g. 2024). Default: newest stored year.

schedule.description: Restrict to large-plan Schedule H or small-plan Schedule I filers.

name: form5500_find_by_amount
title: Form5500 Find By Amount
